description: A shirtless man with long dark hair and a feather headband stands on the edge of an adobe rooftop, holding a drawn bow with an arrow nocked. Behind him in the valley a pale mission church with two bell towers is on fire, with thick smoke rising into a dark, stormy sky. Low adobe buildings and distant hills fill the background, and the scene is lit by a dim orange sunset. The painting is an oil-style image that fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
